verdict.rationale: MotherDuck has a dedicated vendor integration page for dbt stating that the dbt-duckdb adapter supports both DuckDB and MotherDuck, and that only the `path:` setting needs to change. Its homepage also positions running dbt workloads on its instance sizes. The evidence is thin, though: a few short snippets, with no detail on supported materializations or profile options and no hands-on corroboration. The adapter is the shared DuckDB adapter rather than a MotherDuck-specific one. Missing for 10: in-depth adapter configuration and materialization docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of dbt runs against MotherDuck.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, dbt is a first-class citizen — a documented adapter or native dbt project support with vendor docs to match

citations.quote: dbt-duckdb is the adapter which allows dbt to use DuckDB and MotherDuck.
The only change needed for motherduck is the `path:` setting.
